name: Claim Dispute Bundle to PLD Disclosure Pack
outcome: Back office flow scoped to the dispute lifecycle. Two-step product-liability disclosure flow: build a two-sided replay-challenge dossier for a disputed execution claim, then build the disclosure and rebuttal pack from the receipts in that bundle. The pack traces the receipts in the step 1 bundle; the operator is responsible for putting only in-window receipts into the claim, because art-308 does not filter receipts by disputed_window. Step 1's insufficient_evidence and bundle_claim_strength travel with the pack next to step 2's trace_digest and gap_in_window, so a pack built after step 1 reported insufficient_evidence never reads as a complete dossier. Prepared for Directive (EU) 2024/2853, transposition 9 December 2026.
